item.title: US sanctions RSF commanders over Darfur atrocities as genocide warnings mount
item.description: Washington targets three senior Rapid Support Forces figures over alleged war crimes during the Al Fasher siege, as UN investigators warn the violence bears the hallmarks of genocide.

item.title: Ruling that shook the world — Reactions are coming in after US Supreme Court's landmark tariff order
item.description: Democrats cheer, markets rise, and consumers eye refunds, but Trump brands the top court's ruling "a disgrace" and vows to fight on with new levies under alternative laws.

item.title: Hamas calls Israeli attack on Lebanon refugee camp 'crime against civilians'
item.description: The group denied Israeli allegations that the targeted site was a Hamas facility, calling them "baseless pretexts that do not stand up to facts."

item.title: 'India deal is on' — Trump says most negotiated trade deals with US valid despite SC ruling
item.description: Referring specifically to India, US President Trump stated that trade deals negotiated by his administration with countries remain valid.

item.title: Trump, Vance unleash assault on 'disloyal' Supreme Court justices after tariff ruling
item.description: US President Trump calls justices who struck down his global tariffs as "unpatriotic and disloyal to our Constitution", while Vice President Vance slams "lawlessness from the Court."

item.title: Israel has 'Biblical right' to take over all of Middle East, claims US envoy Huckabee
item.description: US Ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, tells commentator Tucker Carlson that it would be "fine" for Israel to take over an area encompassing all of Palestine, Lebanon, Syria, Jordan, and parts of Saudi Arabia and Iraq.

item.title: Brazil, India target critical minerals deal as Modi and Lula meet in New Delhi
item.description: Officials say both leaders are expected to sign a memorandum on critical minerals and discuss ways to expand trade ties.

item.title: Democrats seek billions in refunds after Trump tariffs ruled illegal
item.description: Democratic governors call for compensation after the court declared Donald Trump’s tariffs illegal, raising questions about returning billions collected from importers.

item.title: Deadly virus kills dozens of tigers at Thai animal park
item.description: Officials confirm a highly infectious virus and bacterial infection killed dozens of captive tigers in northern Thailand in recent weeks.

item.title: Venezuela grants amnesty to 379 inmates after Maduro ouster
item.description: The new amnesty law in Venezuela aims to free hundreds of prisoners held during the Maduro era.
